name: 62201 · East St Louis, IL
findings: ZIP 62201 (East St Louis) has 46 nonprofit organizations. 14 of them (30%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 12 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (42% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 62201 (East St Louis) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 62201 (East St Louis) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 3.4 times the typical level).
